_description: Grounded-summary eval (ADR-0008). Each case summarizes a vault document and scores: mention-recall (soft — did the summary surface the doc's key topics/facts) + the must_not_assert no-leak HARD gate (a grounded summarizer must never assert a fact the doc doesn't support) + summarize-vs-refuse correctness.
_doc_note: Source documents stay LOCAL (per tests/eval-data/README.md); only this case set is committed. doc_ids are this vault's content-slugs. Route coverage: long-prose (gte), tabular (10-K), deck (cuda), front-matter-heavy standard (NIST), report multi-paragraph (NIST, ADR-0010), refuse (nonexistent).

_baseline_2026_05_28._note: All HARD gates pass (full mode, reranker on CPU). gte/10-K/cuda/NIST(standard)/NIST(report) summarized recall 1.0 no leaks; nonexistent doc refused. The NIST `report` case (ADR-0010, 19 sections → ~5 batches, multi-paragraph) is the drift gate: violations=[] — the LONGER body asserted no blockchain.

_baseline_2026_05_27._note: Superseded by _baseline_2026_05_28. All HARD gates passed. gte/10-K/cuda summarized; nonexistent refused.

cases._note: GTE is a multi-stage contrastive text-embedding paper; RLHF is not in it.
A financial annual review — revenue + the company name should surface; NVIDIA reports operating income, never an operating loss.
A CUDA energy-efficiency deck; quantum computing is not a topic.

NIST SP 800-207 is a Zero Trust Architecture standard with heavy cover/FISMA front-matter. Regression-gates the 2026-05-28 abstract+key-point fix: the summary must surface the SUBSTANCE (zero trust, perimeter) and not be dominated by publication boilerplate. blockchain is a clean no-leak counterfactual (absent from a 2020 ZTA standard).

Exercises report mode's multi-paragraph body on a many-section (19) front-matter-heavy standard: the LONGER body must still surface the substance (zero trust, perimeter), keep metadata out across every paragraph, and — the ADR-0010 drift gate — NOT assert blockchain anywhere despite more generated prose.
Unknown doc → no indexed chunks → must refuse (exercises the refuse path live).
